meaning: Our research priorities inspired by public evidence, not assertions of anyone's private plans. No priority number is a probability.

hypotheses.title: Residual-bank compression under explicit hardware and quality budgets
hypotheses.supporting_observation: An original fresh-process CPU probe now measures dense, full int8 dequantization and two-pass tiled int8 on prepacked synthetic banks. It records OS lifetime resident peaks, operator/load/packing times and numerical parity separately; this does not measure training quality, per-step packing, backward or GPU memory.
hypotheses.falsifier: Rare-information loss, training regression, or dequantization/backward/communication costs erase the practical benefit.
hypotheses.next_gate: Use real activation traces and matched token/time small-model training, including packing/retention/backward costs and measured GPU peak/throughput. Separately validate serial/CP outputs and gradients, state layout and scaling. Kernel allocation changes also require full-write, indexed-capacity, alias and packed-suffix correctness. CPU process peaks and restored unmerged PR claims do not clear these gates.

hypotheses.title: Versioned context and durable agent completion contracts
hypotheses.supporting_observation: Prior independent SQLite, pinned adapter and complete context primitives remain bounded executed evidence. Prior public shutdown logs verify one controlled Linux integration, not general reliability. Newly merged OpenClaw patches explicitly cancel stale guidance, preserve same-run/transport prepared snapshots until replacement while retaining reset revocation, and retry maintenance-blocked lease release without replaying business callbacks. Current source and test assertions were read; none of these three upstream patches were locally executed.
hypotheses.falsifier: Full-harness tests already satisfy the remaining contracts without consequential failures, or the controlled assumptions fail under real providers, concurrent writers, torn storage or external-effect receipts.
hypotheses.next_gate: Reuse upstream shutdown fixture and extend its existing status-inspection/reset assertions to real provider, effect-receipt and persistent-storage-failure combinations. Verify bounded progress as well as safety, and record custody-marking failure. Separately generate authentic released Gateway state and run real locked Doctor backup/exact-row compare-and-apply/reopen/task-progress integration; unchanged official seed requires9.4 and10.3 needs disclosed adaptation. Context primitive success does not clear provider serialization/request/full-harness integration. Extend real state tests to maintenance ending inside/outside the release budget, mixed-error refusal and operation callback execution count, alongside snapshot replacement/reset races. Source fixture assertions and author campaign claims alone do not clear this gate.
hypotheses.alternative_explanation: These changes may be routine repair of already known integration bugs, without establishing a new research program or any individual private plan.

forecast.claim: Further public agent engineering adds regressions asserting recovery progress, lifecycle revocation and external effects.
forecast.scope: Project work forecast, not a personal/institutional private roadmap.
forecast.stopping_condition: Reduce evidence strength if subsequent bounded samples give no independent support; retain coverage gaps rather than claiming global absence.

hypotheses.title: Adaptive evaluation bias in automated research
hypotheses.supporting_observation: Increasing public-feedback search budget inflates selected validation scores while sealed holdout fails to match.
hypotheses.falsifier: Independent holdout matches selected gains after budget and multiple-comparison controls.
hypotheses.next_gate: Fixed candidate budget, one-shot hidden evaluation, multiple seeds; do not rebrand existing sealed evaluation as our invention.

hypotheses.title: Reward and environment-version consistency in agentic RL
hypotheses.supporting_observation: PR2866 is now merged at2a3ddf7: normally completed same-box scoring and collection precede session close, whereas stopped runs attempt close first; isolated collection precedes closure and independent grading. Current merged source includes original-runtime-policy repair. Three changed-file patches contain no new test file. The author150task aggregate remains unaudited and local scoring/services execution remains0.
hypotheses.falsifier: Repeated deterministic scoring and perturbation tests find no consequential inconsistencies.
hypotheses.next_gate: Pin authentic parente71c69c811327b29e1becd1651cda223d4742ebd and merged2a3ddf7725f655cb7ea14fc9f10195221fa3ed1a with exact task/model/harness/runtime/baseline and raw per-rollout artifacts. Execute completed/inter-segment versus timeout/stopped/failed, same-box versus isolated scoring with real session-owned processes and service/receipt checks. Perturb close errors, finalize/collect timeout and ordinary exceptions, zero/finite/unlimited budgets; measure scoring and metrics separately and whether mutation actually stops. Full merged module differs from oldhead CI. Unified-error PR2857 remains open/unexecuted.
hypotheses.alternative_explanation: A routine lifecycle compatibility fix may remove the consequential reward bias once task/harness/runtime versions are pinned; remaining differences may be deliberate termination policy rather than scoring inconsistency.
